task: Project the approved REVIEW Finding triage policy into active Agent prompts and role guidance without changing Dynamic Finding runtime authority.
outcome: When the user inspects generated prompts, all five active REVIEW Agents show the same English triage rules in both supported envelope modes, non-REVIEW Agents do not show those rules, and verification reports that prompt metadata did not become lifecycle gate evidence.
facts: The Dynamic Finding System execution plan is authoritative for schemas, applicability, gate impact, freshness, and supersession.
The five active REVIEW lanes are behavior, concept, docs, quality, and test-coverage.
Reviewer prompt bodies are assembled centrally by prompt-registry.ts in full-envelope and legacy-full-context modes.
Role-contract requiredCheckIds are declarative metadata and are not execution proof.
Current compatibility finding_dismiss behavior is not a substitute for applicability assessment.
The focused RED/GREEN path is npm --prefix packages/main run build followed by prompt-registry-smoke and prompt-full-context-envelope-smoke from dist; no new validate command is needed.

The prompt baseline verifier supports --write for generated baseline artifacts, while exact approval manifest hashes remain an explicit reviewed pin change in scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs.
constraints: All new prompt and tracked documentation prose must be English for open-source use.
Reviewer severity, evidence state, applicability candidate, and gate impact must remain separate axes.
Unknown applicability for a finding that would otherwise block must fail closed.
No reviewer repair, dismissal, follow-up Story creation, silent severity rewrite, or unilateral scope widening.
No Dynamic Finding runtime schema, handler, gate predicate, freshness, or supersession changes.
Use RED before implementation and prove GREEN afterward.
Run verify_codex because adapter prompt assets and assembly semantics change.
